items.name: BufferSpec
items.summary: Layout specification for a single data type buffer

items.name: layout
items.summary: Return the expected [`DataTypeLayout`] Arrays of this data type are expected to have

items.name: ArrayData
items.summary: A generic representation of Arrow array data which encapsulates common attributes and operations for Arrow array.

methods.name: align_buffers
methods.summary: Verifies that the buffers meet the minimum alignment requirements for the data type

methods.name: buffer
methods.summary: Returns the `buffer` as a slice of type `T` starting at self.offset

methods.name: buffers
methods.summary: Returns the [`Buffer`] storing data for this [`ArrayData`]

methods.name: builder
methods.summary: Returns a builder to construct a [`ArrayData`] instance of the same [`DataType`]

methods.name: child_data
methods.summary: Returns a slice of children [`ArrayData`]. This will be non empty for type such as lists and structs.

methods.name: claim
methods.summary: Claim memory used by this ArrayData in the provided memory pool.

methods.name: data_type
methods.summary: Returns a reference to the [`DataType`] of this [`ArrayData`]

methods.name: get_array_memory_size
methods.summary: Returns the total number of bytes of memory occupied physically by this [`ArrayData`] and all its [`Buffer`]s and children. (See also diagram on [`ArrayData`]).

methods.name: get_buffer_memory_size
methods.summary: Returns the total number of bytes of memory occupied by the buffers owned by this [`ArrayData`] and all of its children. (See also diagram on [`ArrayData`]).

methods.name: get_slice_memory_size
methods.summary: Returns the total number of the bytes of memory occupied by the buffers by this slice of [`ArrayData`] (See also diagram on [`ArrayData`]).

methods.name: into_builder
methods.summary: Converts this [`ArrayData`] into an [`ArrayDataBuilder`]

methods.name: into_parts
methods.signature: fn into_parts(self) -> (DataType, usize, Option<NullBuffer>, usize, Vec<Buffer>, Vec<ArrayData>)
methods.summary: Return the constituent parts of this ArrayData

methods.name: is_empty
methods.summary: Returns whether this [`ArrayData`] is empty

methods.name: is_null
methods.summary: Returns whether the element at index `i` is null

methods.name: is_valid
methods.summary: Returns whether the element at index `i` is not null

methods.name: len
methods.summary: Returns the length (i.e., number of elements) of this [`ArrayData`].

methods.name: new_empty
methods.summary: Returns a new empty [ArrayData] valid for `data_type`.

methods.name: new_null
methods.summary: Returns a new [`ArrayData`] valid for `data_type` containing `len` null values

methods.name: new_unchecked
methods.signature: unsafe fn new_unchecked(data_type: DataType, len: usize, null_count: Option<usize>, null_bit_buffer: Option<Buffer>, offset: usize, buffers: Vec<Buffer>, child_data: Vec<ArrayData>) -> Self
methods.summary: Create a new ArrayData instance;

methods.name: null_count
methods.summary: Returns the total number of nulls in this array

methods.name: nulls
methods.summary: Returns a reference to the null buffer of this [`ArrayData`] if any

methods.name: offset
methods.summary: Returns the offset of this [`ArrayData`]

methods.name: ptr_eq
methods.summary: Returns true if this `ArrayData` is equal to `other`, using pointer comparisons to determine buffer equality. This is cheaper than `PartialEq::eq` but may return false when the arrays are logically equal

methods.name: slice
methods.signature: fn slice(&self, offset: usize, length: usize) -> ArrayData
methods.summary: Creates a zero-copy slice of itself. This creates a new [`ArrayData`] pointing at the same underlying [`Buffer`]s with a different offset and len

methods.name: try_new
methods.signature: fn try_new(data_type: DataType, len: usize, null_bit_buffer: Option<Buffer>, offset: usize, buffers: Vec<Buffer>, child_data: Vec<ArrayData>) -> Result<Self, ArrowError>
methods.summary: Create a new ArrayData, validating that the provided buffers form a valid Arrow array of the specified data type.

methods.name: validate
methods.summary: "cheap" validation of an `ArrayData`. Ensures buffers are sufficiently sized to store `len` + `offset` total elements of `data_type` and performs other inexpensive consistency checks.

methods.name: validate_data
methods.summary: Validate that the data contained within this [`ArrayData`] is valid

methods.name: validate_full
methods.summary: Performs a full recursive validation of this [`ArrayData`] and all its children

methods.name: validate_nulls
methods.summary: Validates the values stored within this [`ArrayData`] are valid without recursing into child [`ArrayData`]

methods.name: validate_values
methods.summary: Validates the values stored within this [`ArrayData`] are valid without recursing into child [`ArrayData`]

methods.name: add_buffer
methods.summary: Adds a single buffer to the [ArrayData]'s buffers

methods.name: add_buffers
methods.signature: fn add_buffers<I: IntoIterator<Item = Buffer>>(self, bs: I) -> Self
methods.summary: Adds multiple buffers to the [ArrayData]'s buffers

methods.name: add_child_data
methods.summary: Adds a single child data to the [ArrayData]'s child data

methods.name: align_buffers
methods.summary: Ensure that all buffers are aligned, copying data if necessary

methods.name: buffers
methods.summary: Sets the buffers of the [ArrayData]

methods.name: build
methods.summary: Creates an `ArrayData`, consuming `self`

methods.name: build_unchecked
methods.summary: Creates an array data, without any validation

methods.name: child_data
methods.summary: Sets the child data of the [ArrayData]

methods.name: data_type
methods.summary: Creates a new array data builder from an existing one, changing the data type

methods.name: len
methods.signature: const fn len(self, n: usize) -> Self
methods.summary: Sets the length of the [ArrayData]

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Creates a new array data builder

methods.name: null_bit_buffer
methods.summary: Sets the `null_bit_buffer` of the [ArrayData]

methods.name: null_count
methods.summary: Sets the null count of the [ArrayData]

methods.name: nulls
methods.summary: Sets the null buffer of the [ArrayData]

methods.name: offset
methods.signature: const fn offset(self, n: usize) -> Self
methods.summary: Sets the offset of the [ArrayData]

methods.name: skip_validation
methods.signature: unsafe fn skip_validation(self, skip_validation: bool) -> Self
methods.summary: Skips validation of the data.

items.name: DataTypeLayout
items.summary: Layout specification for a data type

methods.name: new_binary
methods.summary: Describes a basic numeric array where each element has a fixed with offset buffer of type `T`, followed by a variable width data buffer

methods.name: new_empty
methods.summary: Describes arrays which have no data of their own (e.g. RunEndEncoded).

methods.name: new_fixed_width
methods.summary: Describes a basic numeric array where each element has type `T`

methods.name: new_list_view
methods.summary: Describes a list view type

methods.name: new_nullable_empty
methods.summary: Describes arrays which have no data of their own but may still have a Null Bitmap (e.g. FixedSizeList)

methods.name: new_view
methods.summary: Describes a view type

items.name: ArrayDataRef
items.summary: A thread-safe, shared reference to the Arrow array data.
